GOV-F-003-S77.title: Expired Lock Detection and Recovery Logic
GOV-F-003-S77.description: Implement logic to detect expired locks based on TTL and safely allow new ownership acquisition. Include recovery flow that marks stale locks as expired and prevents race conditions during takeover.

GOV-F-003-S78.title: Admin Override and Forced Unlock Mechanism
GOV-F-003-S78.description: Provide a secure admin override capability to forcibly release or reset locks in failure scenarios, ensuring alignment with existing governance and safety controls.

GOV-F-003-S79.title: Lock TTL Expiry and Concurrency Test Suite
GOV-F-003-S79.description: Create unit and integration tests covering TTL expiry, concurrent acquisition attempts, renewal edge cases, and recovery scenarios to ensure lock reliability under contention.

GOV-F-003-S80.title: End-to-End Integration with Assignment Queue
GOV-F-003-S80.description: Integrate lock enforcement with assignment_queue processing to ensure only one active executor processes a given assignment, including retry behavior after TTL expiry.
